plugin.name: Ansible
plugin.description: Run Ansible playbooks and ad-hoc commands from a control host, with an inventory made from your Termix hosts.

use.title: Use Ansible
use.description: See playbooks and runs on control hosts you can reach. Edit files and run Ansible on hosts you can edit.

enable.label: Ansible
enable.description: Use this host as an Ansible control host. Ansible must be installed on it.

projectDir.label: Project folder
projectDir.description: The folder on this host with your playbooks, roles and ansible.cfg.

vaultPasswordFile.label: Vault password file
vaultPasswordFile.description: A file on this host with the Ansible Vault password. Leave empty if you do not use Vault.

readOnly.label: Read only
readOnly.description: Show playbooks and runs but never edit files or start runs on this host.

alertRuns.label: Alert when a run fails
alertRuns.description: Send an alert when a run on this host ends failed or lost. Checked when run state is read.

tab.title: Ansible
tab.error: Could not load Ansible from this host.
tab.disabled: Ansible is turned off for this host. Turn it on in the host settings.
tab.notInstalledTitle: Ansible is not installed on this host
tab.notInstalledHint: Install ansible-core on this host, for example with pipx or your package manager, then refresh.
tab.noSshpass: sshpass is not installed on this host. Hosts that sign in with a password will fail.

files.empty: No files in the project folder yet.
files.noProject: The folder {{dir}} does not exist on this host. Create it, or set another Project folder in the host settings.
files.listFailed: Could not list the project files.
files.name: File name
files.nameHint: A path inside the project folder, like site.yml or roles/web/tasks/main.yml.
files.hint: A playbook is checked for syntax before it is saved. The old file stays if the check fails.

run.title: Run {{playbook}}
run.sourceProjectHint: Use the inventory from ansible.cfg, or a file in the project.
run.sourceTermixHint: Pick hosts from Termix. Folders become folder_ groups and tags become tag_ groups. All of them are in the termix group.
run.inventoryHint: A path inside the project folder. Leave empty to use ansible.cfg.
run.checkHint: Show what would change without changing anything.
run.diffHint: Show the changes made to files.
run.becomeHint: Use sudo on the hosts. A saved Sudo Password is used for Termix hosts.
run.limitHint: Only run on these hosts or groups.

runs.title: Run
runs.truncated: Showing the end of a long output.

adhoc.hint: Run one module on hosts, like ansible all -m ping.
adhoc.patternHint: A host, a group or all.
adhoc.moduleHint: For example ping, command, shell, apt or systemd.
adhoc.argsHint: For command and shell this is the command. For other modules it is key=value pairs.

facts.hint: Gather facts from hosts with the setup module. Needs Termix hosts so each one has a login.
facts.none: No facts came back. Open the run to see why.

card.title: Ansible
card.empty: Turn on Ansible for a host to see its runs here.
